title: Placed Consumer Accounts Stage Schedule: Entry Gates and Accepted Balance Range
content:
Client Services schedule for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. Every debt a client places with Ridgeline is worked at one placement stage. This schedule sets, for each stage, the client-file facts a debt must show to enter that stage and the range of placed balances the stage accepts.

## 1. Entry gates by stage

| Stage | Debt status in the client file | Days past first delinquency | Prior collection agencies on the debt | Other gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | Not yet charged off | From 30 through 179 days | None (0) | none |
| Primary Placement | Charged off or final billed | At least 120 days | None (0) | none |
| Secondary Placement | Charged off or final billed | At least 120 days | Exactly 1 | none |
| Tertiary Placement | Charged off or final billed | At least 120 days | Exactly 2 | none |
| Warehouse Placement | Charged off or final billed | not a gate | At least 2 | At least 730 days past the charge-off date |
| Legal Review Placement | Charged off or final billed | not a gate | not a gate | At least 365 days left before the statute of limitations for suit expires, and a signed credit agreement on file |

## 2. Placed balance accepted by stage

| Stage | Smallest placed balance accepted | Largest placed balance accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | $25.00 | $25000.00 |
| Primary Placement | $50.00 | $75000.00 |
| Secondary Placement | $50.00 | $75000.00 |
| Tertiary Placement | $75.00 | $75000.00 |
| Warehouse Placement | $100.00 | $50000.00 |
| Legal Review Placement | $1500.00 | $250000.00 |

## Notes on reading the schedule

- The "prior collection agencies" column counts the agencies that worked the debt before Ridgeline, as the client file reports it. Secondary Placement and Tertiary Placement each name an exact count; Warehouse Placement names a floor.
- Early-Out Placement is the only stage that takes a debt that has not been charged off, and its window of days past first delinquency is closed at both ends: a debt 30 days past first delinquency meets it, and so does a debt 179 days past; a debt 29 days past or 180 days past does not.
- For Warehouse Placement the age is counted from the charge-off date, not from the first delinquency date.

## Hypothetical reading examples

*Hypothetical client-file facts, used only to show how the table reads.*

| Client-file facts | Gate met |
|---|---|
| Charged off, 200 days past first delinquency, no prior agency | Primary Placement |
| Charged off, 200 days past first delinquency, one prior agency | Secondary Placement |
| Not charged off, 45 days past first delinquency, no prior agency | Early-Out Placement |
| Charged off 400 days ago, three prior agencies | not Warehouse Placement (fewer than 730 days past charge-off) |

A placed balance of $60.00 falls inside the Primary Placement range ($50.00 to $75000.00) but outside the Tertiary Placement range, which starts at $75.00.
